landed.name: CVE-2026-119348
landed.desc: Next.js is a React framework for building full-stack web applications. landed.name: cve-2026-126714-phpAfterShell
landed.desc:
Partially overwritten session files can lead to remote code execution.
The files session save handler, which is the default, writes updated session data into the existing session file without first clearing it. If a write is interrupted, the file can contain the beginning of the new session followed by the end of the old one, and bytes of an ordinary string can later be unserialized as objects. An attacker who can influence the session data, for example through session upload progress, and interrupt a write at a suitable point may inject objects, which can lead to code execution when the application contains a suitable gadget chain. Session data can also be corrupted.
This issue affects PHP versions before 8.2.36, 8.3.* before 8.3.37, 8.4.* before 8.4.28 and 8.5.* before 8.5.13.

landed.name: CVE-2026-129289
landed.desc:
PHP-FPM request smuggling through an unread HTTP request body.
PHP does not discard the unread part of an HTTP request body at request shutdown when the application has opened php://input without reading it to the end. When the front end reuses backend connections, which is not the default in nginx or Apache (for example nginx with fastcgi_keep_conn on, or Apache mod_proxy_fcgi with enablereuse=on), PHP-FPM can parse the leftover bytes as a new FastCGI request. An unauthenticated remote attacker can use a single crafted multipart/form-data request to forge a backend request with chosen parameters such as SCRIPT_FILENAME, REMOTE_ADDR and PHP_ADMIN_VALUE, which can lead to execution of attacker-controlled PHP code. With LSAPI, subsequent requests on the connection can be disrupted.
This issue affects PHP versions before 8.2.36, 8.3.* before 8.3.37, 8.4.* before 8.4.28 and 8.5.* before 8.5.13.

landed.name: CVE-2026-43499-CYL1
landed.desc:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:
rtmutex: Use waiter::task instead of current in remove_waiter()
remove_waiter() is used by the slowlock paths, but it is also used for
proxy-lock rollback in rt_mutex_start_proxy_lock() when invoked from
futex_requeue().
In the latter case waiter::task is not current, but remove_waiter()
operates on current for the dequeue operation. That results in several
problems:
1) the rbtree dequeue happens without waiter::task::pi_lock being held
2) the waiter task's pi_blocked_on state is not cleared, which leaves a
dangling pointer primed for UAF around.
3) rt_mutex_adjust_prio_chain() operates on the wrong top priority waiter
task
Use waiter::task instead of current in all related operations in
remove_waiter() to cure those problems.
[ tglx: Fixup rt_mutex_adjust_prio_chain(), add a comment and amend the
changelog ]

landed.name: CVE-2026-71319
landed.desc: Nuxt is an open-source web development framework for Vue.js. Prior to 3.3.1, Nuxt DevTools (development mode only) exposes a bidirectional RPC channel over the Vite HMR WebSocket via the nuxt:devtools:rpc plugin. On affected versions the channel has no authentication: any client that can reach the Vite HMR endpoint (ws://<host>:<port>/, subprotocol vite-hmr) can call RPC methods, with no token, handshake, or origin check before the channel is established. The updateOptions(), clearOptions(), and openInEditor() methods do not enforce the ensureDevAuthToken check that the other mutating methods use. openInEditor() reads the persisted behavior.openInEditor value and passes it to the launch-editor package, which spawns it as a child process. That value is settable through the equally unauthenticated updateOptions(). An attacker who can reach the HMR port can therefore chain updateOptions('behavior', { openInEditor: '<command>' }) then openInEditor('<any-existing-file>') to execute an arbitrary program on the developer's machine. This issue is fixed in 3.3.1.

landed.name: CVE-2026-115560
landed.desc:
Session serializer mismatch can lead to remote code execution.
Session upload progress, when enabled, can store attacker-controlled data in a session key using the php_binary or php_serialize session serializer. If the same session is later read with the php serializer, because session.serialize_handler is changed at runtime or differs between applications sharing a session store, bytes inside the key can be passed to the unserializer. A remote attacker able to submit a multipart upload can inject objects, which may lead to code execution when the reading application contains a suitable gadget chain, or to session corruption or denial of service.
This issue affects PHP versions 8.2.* before 8.2.36, 8.3.* before 8.3.37, 8.4.* before 8.4.28 and 8.5.* before 8.5.13.

landed.name: CVE-2026-123007

Impact: An attacker could leverage this vulnerability to crash the NGINX worker process, corrupt its memory, or potentially execute code remotely. There is no control plane exposure; this is a data plane issue only.

landed.name: CVE-2026-110486
landed.desc: In Eclipse Mosquitto versions 2.1 through 2.1.2, a listener configured with `protocol websockets` mishandles empty WebSocket data frames. `net__read_ws()` in `lib/net_ws.c` returns the number of framing bytes consumed (the 4 masking-key bytes) for a data frame with a zero-length payload, without writing any bytes to the caller’s buffer. The MQTT packet reader in `packet__read_single()` (`lib/packet_mosq.c`) trusts that return value as a payload byte count. A remote client can therefore advance the read position over an uninitialised heap allocation, causing the broker to process and forward uninitialised heap memory (information disclosure, including heap and libc pointers), and can underflow the unsigned `to_process` counter so that subsequent attacker-controlled frame data is written past the end of the allocation (heap out-of-bounds write). The out-of-bounds write is reachable from the CONNECT packet before any authentication check, so an unauthenticated client can corrupt the heap and crash the broker even when `allow_anonymous false` is set. Combining the disclosure and the write allows remote code execution as the broker’s user by any client able to establish a session.

landed.name: CVE-2021-44228-PoC
landed.desc: Apache Log4j2 2.0-beta9 through 2.15.0 (excluding security releases 2.12.2, 2.12.3, and 2.3.1) JNDI features used in configuration, log messages, and parameters do not protect against attacker controlled LDAP and other JNDI related endpoints. An attacker who can control log messages or log message parameters can execute arbitrary code loaded from LDAP servers when message lookup substitution is enabled. From log4j 2.15.0, this behavior has been disabled by default. From version 2.16.0 (along with 2.12.2, 2.12.3, and 2.3.1), this functionality has been completely removed. Note that this vulnerability is specific to log4j-core and does not affect log4net, log4cxx, or other Apache Logging Services projects.

landed.name: CVE-2026-90436
landed.desc:
** UNSUPPORTED WHEN ASSIGNED ** Deserialization of an inbound SOAP fault in Apache Axis 1.x allows unauthenticated remote class instantiation. When a SOAP <Fault> carries a <detail><exceptionName> element, Axis loads the named class and, if a String <data> element is also present, instantiates it through its String constructor before checking that it is an AxisFault. Loading alone runs the class's static initializer. With a suitable class on the application's classpath this leads to remote code execution. The fault is parsed while the engine resolves the target service, before any per-service handler chain runs, so authentication handlers configured on a service do not protect against it. This affects all Apache Axis 1.x versions through 1.4.
As Axis 1 has been EOL we recommend you migrate to a different SOAP engine, such as Apache Axis 2/Java. Alternatively you could use a build of Axis with the patch from https://github.com/apache/axis-axis1-java/commit/41f3b4e8d04e310ca81f86b92630ab2c11d608bd applied. The Apache Axis project does not expect to create an Axis 1.x release fixing this problem.

landed.name: CVE-2026-73504
landed.desc: cassandra-jdbc-wrapper provides a JDBC-compliant API over the Java driver for Apache Cassandra. Prior to 4.16.4 and 5.0.2, DriverUtil.toStringWithoutSensitiveValues() and DriverUtil.redactSensitiveValuesInJdbcUrl() redact the password property but not the equally sensitive token property used for DataStax Astra and other token-based authentication. When DEBUG logging is enabled, SessionHolder passes connection properties and JDBC URLs containing token through these helpers, causing the live token to be written in plaintext when connections are acquired or released. An attacker who can read those logs can use the token to access Cassandra data and operations authorized to that credential. This issue is fixed in versions 4.16.4 and 5.0.2.

landed.name: odinroot

landed.name: CVE-2026-116442
landed.desc: Dell PowerStore SDNAS contains an authentication-bypass-by-replay vulnerability in the NAS NDMP service that could allow a network attacker to gain backup and restore control of the appliance.

landed.name: CVE-2026-75521
landed.desc: Miren Runtime provides the runtime component for the Miren application platform. Prior to 0.11.1, the QUIC/HTTP3 RPC server on the default port 8443 uses tls.RequestClientCert and does not verify that presented certificates chain to the configured cluster certificate authority. The RPC authenticators derive a caller identity from PeerCertificates[0].Subject.CommonName without requiring a non-empty VerifiedChains value, and certificate identities bypass all RBAC checks. A network attacker who can reach the listener can present a self-signed certificate with an issuer distinguished name matching the public cluster CA subject and gain cluster superuser access, allowing disclosure, modification, or disruption of applications, sandboxes, disks, credentials, and other managed resources. This issue is fixed in version 0.11.1.

landed.name: CVE-2026-130648
landed.desc: WWBN AVideo from 6.5 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows users with upload permission to inject script by submitting a javascript: scheme videoLink for embed videos. The unvalidated URL is rendered into an iframe src in videoEmbeded.php and PlayerSkins.php, executing for viewers including administrators and enabling creation of new administrator accounts.

landed.name: nginx-http2-cve-2026-123007-lab
landed.desc:
This issue affects NGINX Plus or NGINX Open Source configurations that use HTTP/2. When NGINX processes undisclosed traffic, the flow control window can exceed the allowed threshold, potentially resulting in a heap buffer overflow typically followed by an NGINX worker segmentation fault. Additionally, attackers can execute code on systems with Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR) disabled or when the attacker can bypass ASLR.
Impact: An attacker could leverage this vulnerability to crash the NGINX worker process, corrupt its memory, or potentially execute code remotely. There is no control plane exposure; this is a data plane issue only.
Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

landed.name: nginx2root
landed.desc:
When NGINX Plus or NGINX Open Source is configured to use HTTP/2 for client connections and proxy client requests to a backend, a specially crafted request can result in use-after-free in the worker process, if this process is running low on worker_connections. Additionally, attackers can execute code on systems with Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR) disabled or when the attacker can bypass ASLR.
Impact:
This vulnerability may allow remote attackers to cause a denial-of-service (DoS) on the NGINX system or may allow a code execution. There is no control plane exposure; this is a data plane issue only.
Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

landed.name: APACHE-CVE-2026-129448
landed.desc:
Deserialization of Untrusted Data in Apache Roller versions 4.0.0 through 6.1.4 allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code. The XML-RPC endpoint accepts vendor extension types and deserializes them before authenticating the requester.
This is the same vulnerability as CVE-2026-82384, which listed only Apache Roller 6.1.5 as affected. This issue is being actively exploited.
Users are recommended to upgrade to Apache Roller 6.1.6 or later, which disables the extension types and rejects XML-RPC requests when the XML-RPC feature is disabled.
Users who cannot upgrade right away should set "enabledForExtensions" to "false" in WEB-INF/web.xml, or remove the "/roller-services/xmlrpc" servlet mapping, and restart Roller. Disabling XML-RPC in the administration UI is not enough, because older versions deserialize the request before checking that setting.

landed.name: CVE-2026-126978
landed.desc:
Philips Hue Bridge hap_pair_setup_handler Heap-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Philips Hue Bridge. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.
The specific flaw exists within the HomeKit Accessory Protocol service, which listens on TCP port 8080 by default. When parsing pairing requests, the process does not properly validate the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length, heap-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the device. Was ZDI-CAN-28434.

landed.desc: Vite is a frontend tooling framework for javascript. Vite exposes content of non-allowed files using ?inline&import or ?raw?import. Only apps explicitly exposing the Vite dev server to the network (using --host or server.host config option) are affected. This vulnerability is fixed in 6.2.4, 6.1.3, 6.0.13, 5.4.16, and 4.5.11.

landed.name: CVE-2026-124990
landed.desc: The Masteriyo LMS – LMS Course Builder, Quizzes & Certificates plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to PHP Object Injection in versions up to, and including, 3.5.1 via deserialization of untrusted input in the course importer. The set_post_metas() method  calls maybe_unserialize() on attacker-controlled postmeta string values parsed from the uploaded JSON import file. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary PHP Objects. Exploitation by unauthenticated attackers requires that the site has enable_instructor_registration=true AND enable_guest_checkout=true AND at least one purchasable course exists. Install.php sets enable_instructor_registration=false on fresh installs, so this is a non-default configuration. On a default installation, where that is not configured, the vulnerability requires attackers with author-level access and above.

landed.name: CVE-2026-123640
landed.desc:
Description
When NGINX Plus or NGINX Open Source is configured with the ngx_stream_ssl_preread_module module, a specially crafted ClientHello message from an unauthenticated attacker causes forged values of the ngx_stream_ssl_preread_module variables, affecting virtual server selection. In addition, it may also cause a disagreement with a proxied server terminating the SSL/TLS connection without Transport Layer Security (TLS) 1.3 support.
Impact
This vulnerability may allow an attacker to forge values of the ngx_stream_ssl_preread_module variables and bypass the NGINX systems stream routing segmentation. As a result, the attacker may be able to route the connection to a privileged or internal backend that should be unreachable and gain access to sensitive information. There is no control plane exposure; this is a data plane issue only.
Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

landed.name: CVE-2026-120967
landed.desc:
When NGINX Plus or NGINX Open Source is configured to require client certificates ("ssl_verify_client on") in a non-default stream virtual server, a remote attacker could bypass verification of client certificates.
Impact:
An attacker could leverage this vulnerability to bypass verification of client certificates. There is no control plane exposure; this is a data plane issue only.
Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

landed.name: CVE-2026-120993
landed.desc:
When NGINX Plus or NGINX Open Source is configured to use the ngx_stream_ssl_module module with dynamic certificate loading and the ngx_stream_proxy_module module with the proxy_protocol v2 directive, an abbreviated SSL handshake can cause a worker process to terminate.
Impact:
This vulnerability may allow remote attackers to cause a denial-of-service (DoS) on the NGINX system. This is a data plane vulnerability only; there is no control plane exposure.
Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

landed.name: CVE-2026-113425
landed.desc:
When NGINX Plus or NGINX Open Source is configured as a mail proxy, undisclosed traffic can cause a use-after-free in an nginx worker process. Additionally, attackers can execute code on systems with Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR) disabled or when the attacker can bypass ASLR.
Impact:
A remote unauthenticated attacker may crash an nginx worker process or corrupt its memory, disrupting service. Remote code execution is a potential impact. There is no control plane exposure; this is a data plane issue only.
Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

landed.name: CVE-2026-118899

As a result, the worker process stops accepting new connections and processing existing connections. Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.
Impact: This vulnerability allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to cause a denial-of-service (DoS) of NGINX. There is no control plane exposure; this is a data plane issue only.
Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

landed.name: meta-firmdura-kirkstone
landed.desc:
libwebsockets HTTP/2 HPACK Path Header Parsing Out-Of-Bounds Write Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of libwebsockets. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.
The specific flaw exists within the parsing of HTTP/2 HPACK path header. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in a write past the end of an allocated buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process. Was ZDI-CAN-31036.

landed.name: GeoNetwork-UnauthenticatedRCE
landed.desc: GeoNetwork is a catalog application to manage spatially referenced resources. Prior to versions 4.4.12 and 4.2.17, the API endpoint for creating a new formatter via file upload is unprotected and allows the upload of external uncontrolled files. An unauthenticated attacker can upload arbitrary `.xsl` or `.zip` formatter files to the server.  An unauthenticated attacker can write arbitrary files into the GeoNetwork formatter directory. On its own this constitutes unauthorized write access to server storage. The issue is patched in GeoNetwork versions 4.4.12 and 4.2.17.

landed.name: CVE-2026-127222-sglang
landed.desc: SGLang through 0.5.23, fixed in commit 7b5fb39, contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the POST /load_lora_adapter_from_tensors HTTP endpoint, which lacks the @auth_level(AuthLevel.ADMIN_OPTIONAL) decorator applied to its sibling admin endpoints, allowing unauthenticated network-reachable attackers to invoke it without an API key. Attackers can load a LoRA adapter from attacker-supplied serialized tensors to manipulate the served model, and when combined with a separately documented deserialization bypass, achieve unauthenticated remote code execution as root.

landed.name: CVE-2026-111497
landed.desc:
A buffer overflow vulnerability in the Brotli decoder (c/dec/decode.c) in Google Brotli versions 1.0.3 through 1.2.0 on all platforms allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream.
Users need to update any Brotli libraries or binaries between 1.0.3 through 1.2.0 to the latest available version: 1.0.10 or 1.1.1 or 1.2.1.

landed.name: CVE-2026-99288---NoisyTCP-Exploit
landed.desc:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:
inet: reject unhashed sockets during established lookups
TCP established ehash lookups are lockless. The socket caches involved
use SLAB_TYPESAFE_BY_RCU, so memory can be reused before an RCU reader
that retained its old address has finished.
After a tuple match, __inet_lookup_established() and
__inet6_lookup_established() acquire a reference and repeat the tuple
check. They do not check whether the new object is hashed. If the
address is reused for a socket with the same tuple, the lookup can
acquire a reference to the new object and return it while its nulls node
is unhashed.
A PoC that drives reuse with a SYN cookie request socket reproduced the
crash. The new request socket is unhashed and has a NULL rsk_listener.
A lookup that had loaded the address of the old request socket acquired
the reference published by tcp_get_cookie_sock() and returned the new
object. tcp_v4_rcv() then read sk_state through the NULL listener.

landed.name: CVE-2026-121684
landed.desc: The Soledad theme for WordPress is vulnerable to unauthenticated Remote Code Execution in versions up to, and including, 8.7.7 The public penci_more_post_ajax AJAX action feeds infeedads[ads_code] (base64+urldecoded) to penci_safe_shortcode(), whose allowlist regex inspects only the hyphen-truncated outer shortcode name (e.g. 'adinserter') and never the nested [elementor-element k=.. data=..] tag, so do_shortcode() renders an attacker-chosen Elementor element. The rendered penci-featured-sliders widget passes its unsanitized 'style' setting to include dirname(__FILE__)."/{$style}.php", a path-traversal local file inclusion.

landed.name: CVE-2019-9193-exploit
landed.desc: In PostgreSQL 9.3 through 11.2, the "COPY TO/FROM PROGRAM" function allows superusers and users in the 'pg_execute_server_program' group to execute arbitrary code in the context of the database's operating system user. This functionality is enabled by default and can be abused to run arbitrary operating system commands on Windows, Linux, and macOS. NOTE: Third parties claim/state this is not an issue because PostgreSQL functionality for ‘COPY TO/FROM PROGRAM’ is acting as intended. References state that in PostgreSQL, a superuser can execute commands as the server user without using the ‘COPY FROM PROGRAM’.

landed.name: php2shell-docs
landed.desc: PHP uses longjmp() for out-of-memory (OOM) errors to exit the current context and abort handling of the request. Some contexts may not properly account for this scenario and leave request memory in an uninitialized state before performing an allocation. The subsequent request cleanup procedure may read or branch on this memory. Multiple OOM strategies can consistently trigger this condition and lead to remote code execution (RCE).

landed.name: axis-cve-2026-90436-lab-poc
landed.desc:
** UNSUPPORTED WHEN ASSIGNED ** Deserialization of an inbound SOAP fault in Apache Axis 1.x allows unauthenticated remote class instantiation. When a SOAP <Fault> carries a <detail><exceptionName> element, Axis loads the named class and, if a String <data> element is also present, instantiates it through its String constructor before checking that it is an AxisFault. Loading alone runs the class's static initializer. With a suitable class on the application's classpath this leads to remote code execution. The fault is parsed while the engine resolves the target service, before any per-service handler chain runs, so authentication handlers configured on a service do not protect against it. This affects all Apache Axis 1.x versions through 1.4.
As Axis 1 has been EOL we recommend you migrate to a different SOAP engine, such as Apache Axis 2/Java. Alternatively you could use a build of Axis with the patch from https://github.com/apache/axis-axis1-java/commit/41f3b4e8d04e310ca81f86b92630ab2c11d608bd applied. The Apache Axis project does not expect to create an Axis 1.x release fixing this problem.

inet: reject unhashed sockets during established lookups
TCP established ehash lookups are lockless. The socket caches involved
use SLAB_TYPESAFE_BY_RCU, so memory can be reused before an RCU reader
that retained its old address has finished.
After a tuple match, __inet_lookup_established() and

check. They do not check whether the new object is hashed. If the

is unhashed.

A lookup that had loaded the address of the old request socket acquired

landed.desc: VMware vCenter contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service. A malicious actor with network access to vCenter may exploit this issue to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the system.

landed.name: CVE-2026-83548-CVE-2026-83549
landed.desc: A Pre-authentication SSRF vulnerability exists in the SMA1000 Appliance Work Place interface due to an unintended alternate access path. A remote unauthenticated attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability to gain unauthorized access to sensitive functionality and perform unauthorized operations.

landed.name: CVE-2026-78287
landed.desc: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection') vulnerability in Staggs STAGGS staggs allows Remote Code Inclusion.This issue affects STAGGS: from n/a through 3.3.0.

landed.name: CVE-2026-119618---RCE-in-APACHE
landed.desc:
Concurrent Execution using Shared Resource with Improper Synchronization vulnerability in Apache HTTP Server's mod_http2 in assign_headers() can lead to RCE.
This issue affects Apache HTTP Server: from 2.4.55 through 2.4.70.
Affected releases of mod_h2 from GitHub: from 2.0.8 through 2.0.42.

landed.name: CVE-2026-9999-PoC
landed.desc: Inappropriate implementation in ANGLE in Google Chrome on Mac prior to 148.0.7778.216 allowed a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside a sandbox via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: High)

landed.name: CVE-2026-119179
landed.desc: A flaw in the connection management layer of the MongoDB Node.js driver can leave a pooled network connection in the pool for reuse while data from an earlier operation is still outstanding on it. In applications that enable an optional client-side operation timeout, an unauthenticated party that can send ordinary requests to the application may cause database replies to be paired with the wrong requests. This may result in unintended disclosure of other users' records, incorrect operation results being returned, and failures of legitimate requests.

landed.name: CVE-2026-124020
landed.desc: Control Web Panel (CWP) before webpanel_version 1.30.6 contains a host header injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to manipulate the password-recovery reset URL by injecting the HTTP Host header into the /v1/lostpass/ route's token generation process. Attackers can lure an automated mail-security scanner into visiting the poisoned reset link to exfiltrate the live recovery token, replay it at /login/index.php?acc=newpass to set a new password, and subsequently abuse the File Manager and Crontab modules to achieve command execution as the targeted hosting account.

landed.name: CVE-2026-116779
landed.desc: FreeSWITCH is a Software Defined Telecom Stack enabling the digital transformation from proprietary telecom switches to a software implementation that runs on any commodity hardware. Prior to 1.11.3, sofia_presence_handle_sip_i_message() split the To user of an inbound SIP MESSAGE on a plus sign and treated the left side as a chat protocol selector. Selecting the api chat proto reached switch_api_execute(), allowing a peer whose MESSAGE was accepted to run FreeSWITCH API commands, including operating-system command sinks, with the daemon's privileges. Inbound chat is enabled on the stock internal and external profiles, and any authenticated profile account is sufficient; stock directory users without password material can also remove that barrier in affected configurations. The flaw permits configuration and credential disclosure, arbitrary call control, and command execution, and exploitation has been observed in the wild. This issue is fixed in version 1.11.3.

landed.name: CVE-2026-129491
landed.desc: Qbian61 forum-java commit 20f7e68 through commit 63152c4 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users to inject script by posting unsanitized comment content rendered via jQuery .html() in the reply dialog. Attackers can post comments with img onerror payloads that execute when victims click Reply, stealing the non-HttpOnly sid session cookie to hijack accounts including administrators.

landed.name: CVE-2026-116331-PoC
landed.desc: Type confusion in PostgreSQL min/max aggregate optimization allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via a user-defined aggregate whose SORTOP option causes the planner to treat the aggregate's input and result as the same type when they differ.  Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.
